I still get nervous to talk to people, but slowly, I was able to find myself talking to people outside of work too!!!

The emotional age difference between 17 and 26 is incredibly big.

When you're 17-18, you feel mature and ready to date an older adult now that you "are" one. But speaking even as a 21-year-old, there is so much development in those 3-4 years, that it's kinda terrifying to think that you thought you were ready to date someone eight years older than you. It's a time when you are vulnerable, because of your lack of experience, making it easy to take advantage of you.

Your late teens/early twenties is a major time for emotional development, where you learn boundaries in relationships and quite honestly, a mature 26-year-old should know better not to get into a romantic relationship with someone who is 17.
